arms.frozen: B original training, A original training, then protected queries only
arms.fresh: B original training, matched protected A prefix, then new-rule A training
arms.relearn: B original training, A original training, then identical new-rule A training

protocol.frozen_control: Frozen and relearn share every original prefix input and label; full trained RAM and outputs must match
protocol.fresh_control: No exposure to old A labels; exactly the same new A teaching cases, repetitions and query order as relearn. This changes learning history, not only visible stale weights
protocol.retention: All B labels after prefix_B are protected in all arms, including during A adaptation
protocol.primary: Final-epoch changed-A development accuracy, measured on separate trajectories with no teaching
protocol.cpu_baseline: Per-court 64-example FIFO nearest neighbour on the exact binary inputs; newest breaks distance ties; same allowed labels; no future physics access
staged_order: if failed, exact-reference CPU screen of only connection counts32 and48
admit at most one qualifying candidate on its first development seed
only after first seed passes, remaining two development seeds
only after all development seeds pass, fresh confirmation seeds one at a time
only after all confirmation seeds pass, wall-paced paddle-control comparison
protocol.selection: One-factor connection count only. At most one candidate may be selected; choose highest worst-seed changed accuracy among candidates passing every development gate; tie fewer connections. No passing candidate means stop hardware expansion.
claims: Same chip across seeds; no independent-device claim
Inputs are host observed-motion codes; no pixel learning or native reinforcement-learning claim
CPU algorithm screens are predictions, not physical measurements
Query-only means unchanged visible RAM; hidden selector history is replayed, not restored
No energy or speed advantage inferred from predictive accuracy
protocol.timing_scope: Same Nano core2, interleaved prepared-input native transaction, native host-thread CPU time, exact-rule C++ compute and practical CPU FIFO nearest-neighbour compute. Excludes feature encoding, bit packing, SSH, RAM capture and trace output; no full-system or power claim.
